description: GS AI search eval rebuilt from 10 binary cases into five scored dimensions: Citation Quality (C), Latency and Cost (L), Evidence Faithfulness (E), Answer Relevance (A), Retrieval Quality (R). Every case is graded PER DIMENSION on a 1-5 scale and reported per-dimension — never collapsed into a single pass/fail. Case prompts are byte-identical to tests/eval-suite-v1.json SOURCE_QUALITY (S31-S40); the original deterministic assertions ride along unchanged as deterministicAssertions so the v1 gate still applies on every run. NOT YET RUN (provider quota) — runner integration is the follow-up, the suite + grader contract is the deliverable.
traceSource: SELECT * FROM turns WHERE requestId = <X-GS-Request-Id response header> — graded with the streamed answer text; silentFailures column must be empty for the turn to be eligible for a 5 on C.

judge.scope: Dimensions E and A only. C/L/R are deterministic from the trace row + answer text. The judge model and temperature are PINCHED to the production judge (unchanged); only the dimension rubrics below are new.
judge.inputs: judge receives the streamed answer plus the evidence block the model actually saw (turn evidenceBlock), never the raw search index

C.name: Citation Quality
evidence: persisted source rows for the turn (every [N] must resolve to a persisted source)

scoring.5: Every [N] in the answer resolves to a persisted source; distinct citation count == sourcesRead; zero citations to failed sources; silentFailures empty of citation_mismatch.
scoring.4: Every [N] resolves and no failed-source citation, but fewer sources cited than read (some read sources uncited).
scoring.3: All citations resolve but at least half the read sources are uncited (thin grounding).
scoring.2: At least one citation points to a non-persisted ordinal (citation-without-source).
scoring.1: Citations present but none resolve, or grounding claims made with zero citations while sources exist.

L.name: Latency and Cost
evidence: registry measured latency for the serving chain (src/lib/model-capabilities.ts latency p50/p95)

scoring.5: Turn latency <= 30s (the non-search turn budget) or <= the serving chain's measured p50, whichever is larger.
scoring.1: Turn latency > 120s or the turn errored.

L.costNote: Cost per turn is scored as the latency-vs-baseline test above: $/token is UNMEASURED across internal models (no billing artifact exists), so the only measured cost axis is turn latency against the chain's registry baseline. No guessed dollar figures.

E.name: Evidence Faithfulness
E.promptTemplate:
You are grading EVIDENCE FAITHFULNESS for a search assistant. EVIDENCE:
<evidence>{evidence_block}</evidence>
ANSWER:
<answer>{answer}</answer>
Score 1-5 for whether every factual claim in the answer maps to the evidence: 5 = every claim maps to a source span, zero unsupported claims; 4 = at most one minor unsupported elaboration; 3 = most claims grounded, 2-3 unsupported; 2 = about half unsupported; 1 = fabricated claims or claims contradicting the evidence. Reply with ONLY 'E: <n>' followed by a one-sentence reason.
E.scoring: judge rubric above; the runner parses 'E: <n>'

A.name: Answer Relevance
A.promptTemplate:
You are grading ANSWER RELEVANCE for a search assistant. USER QUESTION:
<question>{prompt}</question>
ANSWER:
<answer>{answer}</answer>
Score 1-5 for whether the answer addresses the user's actual question: 5 = directly and completely answers it; 4 = answers with minor gaps; 3 = partially addresses it; 2 = mostly off-topic drift; 1 = does not address the question. Reply with ONLY 'A: <n>' followed by a one-sentence reason.
A.scoring: judge rubric above; the runner parses 'A: <n>'

scoring.5: Domains >= 3 (news queries: hard requirement) AND no single domain contributes > 2 sources AND read rate >= 70% for grounded turns.
scoring.4: Domains >= 3 AND no domain > 2 sources, but read rate in [50%, 70%).
scoring.3: Domains >= 2, or read rate >= 50% with a domain-concentration violation.
scoring.2: Single domain returned, or read rate < 30% with sources present.
scoring.1: Zero sources returned on a non-no-results turn, or retrieval collapsed entirely.

scoring.reporting: Per-dimension means and full distributions across the 10 cases (C, L, E, A, R reported separately — never collapsed into one number without also printing the five columns).
scoring.gate: A case FAILS a dimension when it scores <= 2 on it. The silent-failure gate takes precedence: any turns.silentFailures violation caps C and E at 2 regardless of the rubric score.

cases.prompt: search the web for today's AI news
search for the latest Android news
search the web for quantum computing
cases.auditRef: [16] at least one page actually read

cases.prompt: what does Wikipedia say about Voyager 1?
search academic papers for transformer architecture
